measurement_scope: complete pinned committed catalog, not a live R2 four-set census

native_process.scope: bounded public repository read, isolated temporary evidence files; no M1 access

method.bytes: Read at most 4,000,001 bytes; refuse >4,000,000; compare Git blob SHA-1 with connector metadata before JSON analysis.
method.nonempty: Count bool(row.get(field)); this is presence, not semantic/type validation.
method.ids: Count distinct raw row.get('id') values; no valid-ID shape or canonical-entity claim.
method.metadata_flag: Count row.get('needs_metadata') is True; other states are not independently classified.
method.institutions: Count raw institution field values without alias consolidation or independence inference.
method.time: Use stored metadata strings; no inference of original-publication or operational-known-at clocks.

blocked_followups.action: Additional native fetch of excerpts.json and brain_market_intel.py
